winter_tiger_skiing: The tiger's whole head and face are orange like its body, with black stripes; only the small area around the nose and mouth may be white. Do not paint cream cheeks.
winter_chinchilla_gingerbread: Both ears of the chinchilla are the same: if a pink inner ear is outlined on only one ear, color both ears plain gray like the head.
summer_hare_strawberries: Both ears of the hare are colored the same way, plain gray-beige like the head, with no pink inner part.
spring_bunny_watering: The bunny's head and face are one even gray on both sides; only the outlined round cheeks may be pink. All fence boards are the same color.
travel_tapir_raft: Color the whole tapir one plain dark gray, head, body and legs the same, with no light saddle.
hobbies_pug_piano: The pug's head and both ears are one even fawn color; only the outlined face mask around the eyes, nose and mouth is dark brown.
winter_cat_fireplace: The ragdoll cat has a cream body and cream ears with pink inner ears; only its outlined face mask, paws and tail are soft gray-brown.
